content.title: What Are The Major Marathon Qualifying Times? [Updated April 2026]
content.text: All of the seven Abbott World Marathon Majors have qualifying times for faster runners. The major marathon qualifying times vary with age and gender, and each race sets their own qualifying standards and decides how many places are available to time qualifiers. Here’s a comparison of all the marathon major qualifying times. Here are all the details you need to know about how to run a qualifying time for the marathons in Tokyo, Boston, London, Sydney, Berlin, Chicago and New York. You can jump straight to: Tokyo Marathon Boston Marathon London Marathon Sydney Marathon Berlin Marathon Chicago Marathon New York City Marathon Here’s every way to enter each of the World Marathon Majors and here’s when to apply for each Marathon Major. What Are The Major Marathon Qualifying Times? Tokyo Marathon Qualifying Times Tokyo is the hardest Major Marathon to achieve a place on the start line by running a qualifying time. The semi-elite field is for just 280 runners, and for overseas runners there are just 25 places for men and 25 for women as part of the Tokyo Marathon Run As One. Time qualifiers need to have run the following times, and entries are selected as fastest-first so it’s likely you need to run well inside those times. Men’s Marathon: Under 2:28 Women’s Marathon: Under 2:54 For non-residents (and runners who can’t run sub-2:28!), the best chance of running the Tokyo Marathon is a charity place or an international tour. Boston Marathon Qualifying Times The Boston Marathon is the race most famous for its time qualification. 24,000 out of the 30,000 runners of the Boston Marathon have previously run a BQ, or Boston Qualifier time (the others are mainly charity places or sports tours). The qualifying window for the 2027 Marathon began on 13 September 2025. The times are based on your age on the date of the race, not the age you were when you ran your time. Achieving a BQ does not guarantee you entry, but it does ensure that you’re able to submit an application. If the race is over-subscribed then it’s a fastest first system in each category. For 2026’s race, runners had to be 4:34 faster than their BQ standard. If you haven’t run a BQ then here’s how you can still run the Boston Marathon. Here are the qualifying times for the 2026 Boston Marathon. Good For Age places are only available for UK residents. For the 2026 London Marathon, the window in which to run a qualifying time is 1 October 2024 to 30 September 2025. Applications for GFA open from October 2025. For London, the age is how old you were when you ran your time, not your age on race day (which is different from the US races). Running a qualifying time does not guarantee you a place in the race. If you are within 5-10 minutes then you should also apply via the ballot. There is no non-binary category for the London Marathon Good For Age or Championship Entry. The qualifying window is 1 October 2024 to 30 September 2025. Runners must be a member of a UK Athletics club. There will be 1,200 places available in 2026 (600 men, 600 women) and it’s fastest-first if the cap is exceeded. Unsuccessful Championship entries move to GFA places. London Marathon Championship Entry time are: Men: sub 2:38 (or sub 1:11:30 half marathon) Women: sub 3:10 (or sub 1:26 half marathon) You can only use a half marathon time if you haven’t run a marathon. Sydney Marathon Qualifying Times The Sydney Marathon became an Marathon Major for the 2025 running of the race and qualifying times were introduced for the 2026 race. Meeting the qualifying time does not guarantee entry. It’s fastest-first within age and gender categories, and applications will be validated based on sending proof of your qualifying time. Qualifying times for the Sydney Marathon must have been achieved in an AIMS-certified marathon since 1 July 2024, on a course with no greater than 457m of net-elevation drop. Unsuccessful applications will move into the main ballot. If successful, runners pay the standard entry fee. The marathon time has to have been run within the previous two years, and with proof of your time. There is no non-binary category in Berlin. AGE GROUPMALEFEMALE18-442:453:1045-592:553:3060+3:254:20 Chicago Marathon Qualifying Times The Chicago Marathon has guaranteed entry for runners who achieve qualifying times. Guaranteed entry into the Chicago Marathon is based on your age on the date of the race, not the age you were when you ran your time. Chicago also has a high performance programme for faster runners: 2:25 for men and 2:45 for female/non-binary (2:35 and 2:50 for Masters Men and Masters Women/Non Binary). These are the qualifying times for the 2026 Chicago Marathon. NYRR offers non-complementary guaranteed entry to any athlete who meets the time qualifying standards at an in-person NYRR marathon or half marathon within the qualifying window. There are also limited entries for those who run a time qualifying standard at non-NYRR events, but only marathon times count (not half marathons). If oversubscribed, it’s a fastest-first system within each category. Times are net time, not gun time. The times are based on your age on the date of the race, not the age you were when you ran your time. For New York City Marathon 2025, the qualifying window was 1 January 2024 to 31 December 2024. The times in brackets below are half marathon times – these are only applicable to NYRR races. Update: For the 2025 race, runners had to be more than 13 minutes faster than the qualifying time to get a place. Does running a Major Marathon qualifying time guarantee you race entry?No. Only the Chicago Marathon has guaranteed entry based on qualifying times. All other Majors have a qualifying standard which allows runners to apply for race entry. Often there’s a cut-off several minutes faster than the actual qualifying standard. What races count towards qualifying times for Major Marathons?Your time must be run on a course verified by a local athletics governing body and you must prove your time. Can you run the Boston Marathon without a qualifying time?Yes, you can. It’s possible to run the Boston Marathon for charity or via a sports tour programme. Full details on how to run Boston without a BQ here. What does a BQ mean in running?A BQ means you’ve run a Boston qualifying time for the Boston Marathon. That means you can apply to run the race, though it doesn’t guarantee you entry. How do the marathon qualifying times compare?Most times are similar. We’ve created a detailed comparison table of the major marathon qualifying times. Check out the comparison here. READ MORE RANKED: WHAT’S THE HARDEST MAJOR MARATHON? HERE’S HOW TO GET INTO EACH MAJOR MARATHON! Mark is the Content Manager at The Running Channel and is always trying to achieve the qualifying time for his next race.Mark Dredge
